name: Charlie Hipwood
bio: President and CEO of MassVentures, a Massachusetts venture firm investing in early-stage deep-tech startups emerging from research institutions. Longtime investor and ecosystem builder supporting commercialization of academic innovation.

name: Daphne Zohar
bio: Serial biotech entrepreneur and founder of PureTech Health. Known for building breakthrough life-science companies and advancing novel therapeutic platforms across neuroscience, immunology, and digital medicine.

name: David Cancel
bio: Serial entrepreneur and SaaS leader. Founder of Drift and former Chief Product Officer at HubSpot. Focused on conversational marketing and customer-driven product design.

name: Dharmesh Shah
bio: Co-founder and CTO of HubSpot, one of Boston’s most influential SaaS companies. Active angel investor and advocate for startup founders building customer-centric software products.

name: Hemant Taneja
bio: Managing Director at General Catalyst investing in transformative technology companies across AI, healthcare, and enterprise infrastructure. One of the most influential venture investors in Boston.

name: Jeffrey Bussgang
bio: General Partner at Flybridge Capital and Senior Lecturer at Harvard Business School. Early investor in several successful startups and author focused on entrepreneurship and venture capital.

name: John Harthorne
bio: Founder of MassChallenge, one of the world’s largest startup accelerators. Dedicated to helping early-stage founders grow through mentorship, capital access, and global community programs.

name: Jonathan Ortmans
bio: President of the Global Entrepreneurship Network and organizer of Global Entrepreneurship Week. Works globally with governments and innovation hubs to strengthen startup ecosystems.

name: Lee Hower
bio: Co-founder of NextView Ventures, a seed-stage VC firm focused on companies reinventing everyday life. Previously co-founder of Paydiant, acquired by PayPal.

name: Noubar Afeyan
bio: Founder of Flagship Pioneering and co-founder of Moderna. Pioneer in venture creation building breakthrough biotech companies from scientific discoveries.

name: Rich Miner
bio: Partner at GV and co-founder of Android. Focuses on early-stage startups in mobile, AI, and frontier technology.

name: Rudina Seseri
bio: Founder of Glasswing Ventures investing in early-stage AI and cybersecurity companies. Active supporter of diverse founders and innovation policy initiatives.

name: Semyon Dukach
bio: Managing Partner at One Way Ventures investing in immigrant founders in the U.S. Former Managing Director at Techstars Boston.

name: Stephanie Roulic
bio: Founder of Startup Boston, a community platform connecting founders, operators, and investors across the Massachusetts startup ecosystem.

name: Trae Vassallo
bio: Co-founder of Defy.vc and former General Partner at Kleiner Perkins. Investor in early-stage enterprise and AI companies and advocate for diversity in venture capital.

name: Vinit Nijhawan
bio: Managing Director at MassVentures supporting early-stage deep-tech startups and research spinouts across Massachusetts.
